---
title: "Workshop setup"
---

## Software

Install:

- R (recent release)
- RStudio Desktop or another R IDE
- Quarto (only needed to render/edit the teaching site)
- Git (recommended)

Then run:

```r
source("scripts/00_setup.R")
```

The core hands-on analysis uses `Seurat`. Later exercises optionally use `dplyr`, `ggplot2`, `patchwork`, and `Matrix`.

## Load the synthetic dataset

```r
library(Seurat)

counts <- read.csv(
  "data/synthetic_immune_counts.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
metadata <- read.csv("data/synthetic_immune_metadata.csv")
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$cell_id

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = as.matrix(counts),
  meta.data = metadata,
  project = "scrna_workshop"
)
obj
```

::: {.callout-warning}
The synthetic dataset is intentionally small and simplified. It is suitable for learning mechanics and interpretation, not for benchmarking biological performance.
:::

## Recommended folder workflow

Open `scrna-seq-workshop.Rproj` and keep the project root as the working directory. Avoid hard-coded absolute paths so the same code works for every participant and on GitHub/Codex.
